title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 bit225, 4-bit MLA latent KV, INT4 DFlash + 48 GB SSD KV
summary: Full GLM-5.3 (743B) on just two DGX Sparks (256 GB unified memory total) at TP=2 with upstream gr8: EXLR8 bit225 mixed-precision weights, 4-bit MLA latent KV (416 B/layer/tok excl. indexer), native INT4 DFlash + MTP=1, and built-in 48 GB NVMe SSD KV store. Live-verified at RealMark 800.4 Grade A (98.4 tok/s C=4 aggregate decode, 99.2% cache hit across 293K active C=4 context), 140/200 (70.0%) on 200 coding/math/science tasks (86.25% HumanEval+), and 21/24 (87.5%) on 32K-128K hard long-context (100% needle & doc-QA recall to 128K).

configs.label: TP=2 · SSD KV
configs.notes: Measured 2026-11-27 on upstream ghcr.io/kindlingai/gr8:main@sha256:494c44b2 (fa5d82d3) across 2 DGX Sparks (256 GB unified memory total), bit225 EXLR8 weights (501d2598), native INT4 DFlash (incoai/GLM-5.3-DFlash2 @ 425aa615, tp2-int4) + MTP=1, 4-bit MLA latent KV (416 B/layer/tok excl. indexer), and 48 GB NVMe SSD KV_STORE with GR8_MEM_MIN=1. RealMark ran with --stage-prefill-rate 300 (Thinking OFF, C=1 16/16 801.1, C=2 10/16 810.5, C=4 8/16 789.7; 293K active C=4 context; 5/34 word flags). Cold prefill points measured from 24-task deterministic 32K/64K/128K long-context suite at CAP=135168 SESS=2 (Thinking ON; 38.7 tok/s decode at 128K). Warm boot 87-88 s; MemAvailable floor 0.064-0.088 GiB; 0 API errors; 0 OOMs.
